## Changelog
• sync to latest NekoBox version (1.4.2)
• add disabled bottom sheet menu
• add reverse to old style
• add gif support in all banner (but, if it's a GIF, the cropping process won't work. Basically, GIFs can't be cropped.)
• add hide particles animation in banner
• add host checker
• add new banner home
• add share button to bottom sheet (This can be disabled if you enable "disabled bottomsheet in homepage" in Miku's wardrobe)
• dropped support xhttp transport because official nekobox not supported this transport
• fixed and improvement

## Notes
If some subscriptions do not find the proxy, please change the user agent to NekoBox, thx
![Screenshot_20260222-234201_MikuBox~2](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/322be61d-facf-45c5-82b6-729179241f85)

# End of Life version, I will not update anymore, from now on I will just follow what the NekoBox developers do.
